category_title: At-risk middle school students demonstrating high engagement and professional presentation skills in STEM
scenario_title: STEM Problem-Based Learning: Extreme Weather Project
minimal_context: The student is assembling a weather box with a radio and flashlight and preparing to present extreme weather safety instructions to the class.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Today we are studying extreme weather. I need you to assemble your weather boxes with the weather radio and flashlight, and write down the instructions for finding safe places. You will present this to me and your classmates at the end of the period.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Why are we just presenting to you and the class again? I'm not genuinely excited about science when we just do the same thing every day.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: That is the assignment for today. Please start working on your instructions.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Turns the flashlight on and off, shining it at the wall instead of writing) This is boring. I don't see the point of making these boxes.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to stay on task and finish the weather box.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm not doing it. You can just give me a referral to the office for discipline because I'm not presenting this to the class.

task.content: Studied extreme weather and presented a community awareness session... created weather boxes that included a weather radio, flashlight, and instructions for finding safe places to wait out storms
task.learning_goal: Dealing with real-life applications of the principles and experiments students should encounter in their middle school science courses

context.materials: Weather boxes that included a weather radio, flashlight, and instructions
context.social_setting: Initially presenting to an audience of 'primarily a teacher and classmates', with the potential for an 'authentic audience' including 'students from neighboring elementary, middle, and high schools, as well as college students and adults', and opportunities to work with 'community partners'

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When receiving 'a teacher's didactic instruction' and presenting to an audience of 'primarily a teacher and classmates'
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Exhibiting 'absences and discipline cases', poor 'attitude', decreased 'time on task', and 'referrals to the office for discipline'
related_quotes: our biggest gains have been in student attendance and attitude
SL has impacted their [students'] behaviors, which has led to an increase of time on task and fewer referrals to the office for discipline.

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Demonstrating 'absences and discipline cases', decreased 'time on task', and 'referrals to the office for discipline'
